description: Canonical magic item property catalog. droppable controls whether a property can appear on naturally dropped items. forgecraftEligible controls whether it appears in the Forgecraft menu. weight controls relative selection probability within the eligible pool. Optional minRarity (e.g. "mythic") restricts a property to only roll when the item's generated rarity matches exactly. adjective/epithet/fragment feed the procedural name composer in LootManager.composeItemName(): adjective is used when this property is the first one rolled, epithet when it's the sole second property (2-property items), fragment when it's one of two non-lead properties (3-property items).

properties.name: Tailored
properties.description: Expertly fitted to the wearer. The maximum DEX modifier that contributes to AC increases by 1.

properties.name: Adaptive
properties.description: Layered and angled to deflect devastating blows. Critical hits against you count as normal hits for damage calculation.

properties.name: Reinforced
properties.description: Structurally strengthened at key stress points. Grants +1 to AC.

properties.name: Optimised
properties.description: Lighter, harder, and tuned to its wielder. Grants an additional +1 AC.

properties.name: Deflecting
properties.description: Shaped to redirect incoming energy. Once per short rest, use your reaction to add your shield's AC bonus to a saving throw.

properties.name: Keen
properties.description: Honed to a razor edge that finds the gaps. Critical hit range expands to 19-20.

properties.name: Tempered
properties.description: Strengthened through expert heat treatment. Grants +1 to damage rolls.

properties.name: Balanced
properties.description: Perfectly weighted for precision. Grants +1 to attack rolls.

properties.name: Voidwoven
properties.description: Threaded through with something that isn't quite metal. The edge doesn't reflect light so much as decline it.

properties.name: Wardbound
properties.description: Bound to its wearer by something that doesn't wear out. No one has explained why, and no one who owns one seems eager to ask.

properties.name: Absolute
properties.description: Doesn't bend, doesn't dent, doesn't explain itself. Whoever forged it wasn't working from any metallurgy the Verge recognises.
